import http.client,urllib.parse,sys
from pathlib import Path
token=Path.home().joinpath('.config/tgtumbler/tumblr-operation-app/tumblr-app-access-token').read_text().strip()
def run(method,path,body=None,extra=None):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=5)
 h={"Host":"tumblr.hentaigay.org"}
 h.update(extra or {})
 c.request(method,path,body=body,headers=h)
 r=c.getresponse();status=r.status;data=r.read(65536);headers=dict(r.getheaders());c.close()
 return status,data,headers
s,d,_=run("GET","/?from=browser")
if s!=401 or b'action="/session"' not in d:sys.exit(61)
s,d,_=run("GET","/login")
if s!=200 or b'type="password"' not in d:sys.exit(62)
form=urllib.parse.urlencode({"token":token})
s,d,h=run("POST","/session",form,{"Content-Type":"application/x-www-form-urlencoded","Origin":"https://tumblr.hentaigay.org","Accept":"text/html"})
if s!=303 or not h.get("Set-Cookie"):sys.exit(63)
cookie=h["Set-Cookie"].split(";",1)[0]
s,d,_=run("GET","/",extra={"Cookie":cookie})
if s!=200 or b'id="chat-form"' not in d:sys.exit(64)
s,js,_=run("GET","/app.js",extra={"Cookie":cookie})
if s!=200 or b'fetch("/assistant"' not in js:sys.exit(65)
s,css,_=run("GET","/styles.css",extra={"Cookie":cookie})
if s!=200 or b'.workspace' not in css:sys.exit(66)
